CommitExpect.description: What the page showed when the person pressed Commit.

files.description: One entry for every checked path.

ExpectedFile.description: The version of a file the page showed, from `git.status` (or `git.hunks`).

diskBytesHash.description: `git.status.diskBytesHash` as shown, for a file without a text hash (binary, above the text limit).

diskHash.description: `git.status.diskHash` as shown: the text's hash, or null (deleted, binary, above the text limit).

Selected.description: One checked entry of `git.commit`: a whole file, or chosen hunks of it.

chunks.description: Indices of `git.hunks` (HEAD → disk) to commit; absent for the whole file. Not empty when present.

message.description: The commit message (git's `--cleanup=whitespace` applies; not empty after it).

runHooks.description:
"Run Git hooks": false commits with `--no-verify`, which skips `pre-commit` and `commit-msg` only —
`prepare-commit-msg` and `post-commit` run all the same.

changedAfter.description: Files on disk a hook changed while the commit ran.

hookChangedCommit.description: Paths a hook changed in the commit itself (the tree after the hooks differs from what was checked).

hooksSkipped.description: The hooks that were skipped (`--no-verify`): empty when `runHooks` was true.

indexKept.description:
Committed paths whose entry in the person's index was left as it was: a version staged from a terminal
that is neither the old HEAD's nor the committed one.

stream.description: One `stream` frame of `git.commit`: output of git and the hooks, in the order it came.
stream.title: CommitOutput

summary: Commits the checked files and hunks (counted from HEAD) with the companion's own git, in a                   temporary index; the person's index keeps what they staged. Hooks run as in a terminal unless                   `runHooks` is false. Streams the output of git and the hooks; cancellable.
